# Third-party code

## ffmpeg-aac.js

FFmpeg's native AAC-LC encoder compiled to WebAssembly, taken from
[`@mediabunny/aac-encoder`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediabunny/aac-encoder) 1.61.4
by Vanilagy and contributors ([source](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny)).

- Emscripten glue and bridge: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt`).
- FFmpeg (libavcodec): GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later. Source: <https://ffmpeg.org/download.html>.

The file is generated by `tools/vendor-aac.mjs`, which only re-encodes the embedded
WASM binary as base64 and wraps the module as a classic script. The code is otherwise
unmodified. It is used only when the browser has no native WebCodecs AAC encoder.
